project.name: Grass Touching Simulator

recentCommits.message: Speed up first upgrade and add unlock cue
Cover title menu artifacts and fix music toggle
Add seasonal effects and menu music
Add new seed shop and weather content

sessionWorkCompleted: Added several new Weather Jar moods: Soft Rain, Pollinator Swarm, Golden Hour, and Restless Roots.
Added new seed shop content: Rain Barrel, Sprinkler Timer, Self-Seeding Nozzle, Clover Press, and Seed Catalog.
Wired new behavior for longer weather, faster sprinkler ticks, sprinkler seed drops, stronger Wild Spread, rare/crit boosts, and related weather visuals.
Added seasons based on the player's local machine date. Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter apply subtle runtime stat modifiers and a soft season tint.
Added a menu theme WAV at public/assets/music/epic_menu_theme_mellow.wav and wired title-screen playback.
Iterated on title music unlock handling because the user heard no music. Current implementation uses a native HTMLAudioElement and the Options button as an explicit music toggle/status.
Covered baked-in title menu artifact rectangles with a Phaser-rendered pixel-style menu plaque and re-rendered menu labels in code.
Fixed an Options click bug where the first click could start menu music and immediately toggle it off.
Reduced the first Softer Grass upgrade base cost from 8 to 4 grass touches.
Added a bright three-note unlock cue that fires when an upgrade level or seed shop item becomes newly affordable.

playtesterContext.feedbackSoFar: Some Discord playtesters already like the game because the tactile feel is addictive.
playtesterContext.recommendedFeedbackPrompt: Ask testers what felt good, what felt slow, what annoyed them, and whether title music starts after clicking Options.

knownIssuesAndRisks: Menu music may still need verification in the user's browser. If it still says Music: on but is silent, convert the WAV to MP3/OGG and load multiple sources.

The title artifact fix is a rendered menu plaque overlay, not a cleaned bitmap. Verify whether the user likes the look; if not, do a proper art cleanup pass or regenerate/repair only the menu-band region.
The old title PNG still contains baked-in translucent artifact rectangles under the overlay.
The title plaque currently changes the menu presentation more than a pure image cleanup would. This was chosen as the safest shippable fix after local inpainting/patch attempts looked worse.
The skill tree is improved but may still be dense on phone screens when many nodes are unlocked.
Progression balance at high touch counts is still prototype-level.
Large fields plus zoom/pan should continue to be phone-tested for performance and ergonomics.
Vite warns about the Phaser bundle being larger than 500 kB after minification. Not urgent unless load time becomes a real issue.
recommendedNextSteps: Have the user hard-refresh the live site and verify the title plaque, Options music toggle, and first-upgrade pacing.
If music is still silent, convert epic_menu_theme_mellow.wav to MP3 and/or OGG, update TitleScene to provide fallback sources, and redeploy.
If the plaque feels too intrusive, replace it with a proper cleaned title-screen bitmap or ask for/source a cleaner title art file.
Add a small visible build/version marker or changelog line during rapid Discord playtests.
Keep tuning early game pacing around the first 1-5 minutes now that Softer Grass unlocks at 4 touches.
Continue adding seed/weather/field content in small deployable slices.
Improve mobile skill tree usability with zoom, sections, or a cleaner mobile layout.
localEnvironmentNotes: During image cleanup attempts, Python user packages pillow, numpy, and opencv-python were installed with: python -m pip install --user pillow opencv-python.
Temporary image preview files and tmp/title-history were removed before the final commits.
